## Design

### 2026-10-28: Made the pcb today. It was really simple tbh, each board with the WS2812 LED just has two 5V and GND solder points and data in/out. Tomorrow I might start designing the enclosure, then do the  firmwar

**0.88h**

Made the pcb today. It was really simple tbh, each board with the WS2812 LED just has two 5V and GND solder points and data in/out. Tomorrow I might start designing the enclosure, then do the  firmware. I was thinking about using WLED because it's just really easy to setup and has many cool features, but I'll see about that. I can't wait to solder 512 LEDs and like 1600 wires on the building week... (   ._. )

### 2026-10-29: Designed the enclosure today. I added some french cleats, so I'll be able to choose whenever I want the panel to be mounted horizonally or vertically. I cannot wait to solder 512 LEDs on the building

**3.38h**

Designed the enclosure today. I added some french cleats, so I'll be able to choose whenever I want the panel to be mounted horizonally or vertically. I cannot wait to solder 512 LEDs on the building week! ### 2026-10-30: Made the LED diffusers into panels that can be unscrewed. By that I will avoid having to reprint the whole case if for some reason the diffusers would reshape from heat or just mechanical damage. Also

**0.9h**

Made the LED diffusers into panels that can be unscrewed. By that I will avoid having to reprint the whole case if for some reason the diffusers would reshape from heat or just mechanical damage. Also I moved the esp and the voltage regulator to a different spot because else they would collide with the screws
